name: 窄版圖文並排（左文右圓形圖片）
desc: 內容明顯窄於頁面內容寬度的單組圖文並排：左側文字欄垂直置中，右側一張圓形裁切圖片。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。單組圖文左右並排，兩欄各約一半，整組置中且明顯窄於頁面內容寬度。左側是文字欄，靠左對齊，相對右側圖片垂直置中：大標題（可多行），下方是說明文字，再下方可放一段較小的次要文字，沒有時省略；大標題明顯大於說明文字。右側放一張圓形裁切的圖片，直徑約佔畫面寬的三成，文字和圖片不重疊。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：大標題在最上方並置中，下方是靠左的說明文字與次要文字，圓形圖片在最下方置中，約佔畫面寬七成。

en.name: Narrow side-by-side media and text (text left, circular image right)
en.desc: A single side-by-side media-and-text pair clearly narrower than the page content width: a vertically centered text column on the left and an image cropped to a circle on the right.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. A single pair of text and image sits side by side in two columns of about half each; the whole pair is centered and clearly narrower than the page content width. The left column is text, aligned left and vertically centered relative to the image on the right: a headline (may wrap to multiple lines), a description below it, and optionally a smaller piece of secondary text below that; omit it when there is no content. The headline is clearly larger than the description. On the right is an image cropped to a circle whose diameter is about three tenths of the viewport width; the text and the image do not overlap.
en.mobile: Changes to a vertical stack: the headline at the top, centered; below it the left-aligned description and secondary text; the circular image at the bottom, centered, about seven tenths of the viewport width.
